DevopsPipelnStgPromWkItem.name: DevopsPipelnStgPromWkItem
DevopsPipelnStgPromWkItem.description: Represents the association between a work item and a pipeline stage promotion. The object tracks the merge status of the work item into the target stage branch in source control.

DevopsPipelnStgPromId.description: The ID of the parent pipeline stage promotion record.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

MergeCompletionDate.description: The date and time when the merge operation for this specific work item was completed in the source control system.

MergeRemoteReference.description: A unique reference identifier from the remote source control provider, such as a Pull Request ID, for the merge associated with this promotion.

MergeSourceBranchId.description: The ID of the source branch in the repository from which changes were merged for this work item during this promotion.

Name.description: A unique identifier for the pipeline stage promotion work item record.

WorkItemId.description: The ID of the work item that is promoted.
